Definition
[Complete geodesic lamination] 1. Definition 8.7.5\group geodesic laminationsSource: thurston:page-0211 A geodesic lamination on a hyperbolic surface is complete when every complementary component is an ideal polygon (with the finite-area cusp version understood).
